_about: The shot grammar Krish approved on 20 Nov 2026 (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-20: "The shot grammar is approved: build it and run Monday's piece on it"; one staging per cut; generated imagery never). Every number is measured from his good cuts (Character.ai tall and wide, eating its own jobs tall, AI music tall) and The Athletic's "8 facts about Man United's finances", against the rejected Tue 17 short, Wed 18 long and the 9 s long, frame by frame every 0.5 s with a face detector and a hand shot log (docs/ve/INGREDIENTS.md, "Shot grammar"). Read by scripts/velib/grammar.py (ve lint grammar.*) and scripts/velib/shots.py (the planner, ve shots). Binds pieces frozen at ve expect from floor.RECIPE_FROM (2026-11-23).
